description: הפקת הצעת מחיר רשמית, נעולה ושמורה במסד הנתונים עם קישור PDF מאומת. WRITE OPERATION (Stateful): Generates an official, locked, and persisted B2B quote document in TAGLI Quote Builder with a cryptographically signed quote_id and PDF download link. Supports single item or multi-item array (items[]). Supports idempotency_key for safe retries without creating duplicates.

customer_contact.description: Customer contact fields (name, email, phone, company)

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key for safe retries without creating duplicate quote records

items.description: Multi-item lines array for one unified Quote Builder quote + single PDF. Each item: {product_id, quantity, options: {color, branding, sleeve, sizes, variation_id}}

options.description: Product options (color, branding, sleeve, sizes, variation_id)

product_id.description: TAGLI WooCommerce Product ID (for single-item requests; omit when using items[])

quantity.description: Requested package quantity (for single-item requests; omit when using items[])

name: agentic_quote
title: Create Official B2B Quote
